description: Find media and files in a project's asset library, the same library shown in the Assets app. Pass searchTerm to search in relevance order; omit it to list the whole library, newest first, a page at a time. Returns up to 50 assets unless limit says otherwise. Use this both to answer "what assets do I have" and to locate a specific asset. For multi-step Replo work, call skills with name "replo".

createdAtGte.description: Only assets created at or after this ISO datetime.

createdAtLte.description: Only assets created at or before this ISO datetime.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor the previous page returned as its next cursor. Ignored when searchTerm is set because semantic search returns one ranked page.

label.description: Only return assets carrying this label.

limit.description: Maximum number of assets to return. Defaults to 50.

orderBy.description: Sort order when listing (ignored when searchTerm is set). Prefix a field with '-' for descending. Defaults to -createdAt (newest first).

projectId.description: The project whose asset library to search.

searchTerm.description: Search query. When set, assets come back in relevance order (semantic, tag, and name matching) as one ranked page. Omit to list assets, sorted by orderBy.

status.description: Restrict to one lifecycle state: approved, draft (neither approved nor archived), or archived.

tags.description: Only return assets carrying all of these tags.

type.description: Restrict results to a single asset type.

updatedAtGte.description: Only assets updated at or after this ISO datetime.

updatedAtLte.description: Only assets updated at or before this ISO datetime.

name: find_assets
title: Find assets
